Log And Trace Extract Template
A.3.2
Measurement with Reference to a Unit
The definition of a DltArgument that represents a measurement with a unit is de-
picted in the example in Listing A.6.
The difference to the example presented in
Chapter A.3.1 is the reference to the Unit with the shortName set to “Kelvin”.
<DLT-ARGUMENT>
<SHORT-NAME>reading</SHORT-NAME>
<DESC>
<L-2 L="EN">reading</L-2>
</DESC>
<DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPSS>
<DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS-REF-CONDITIONAL>
<DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS-REF DEST="DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS">/Dlt_Example/
DltArgumentPropsExampleSet/reading</DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS-REF>
</DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS-REF-CONDITIONAL>
</DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPSS>
</DLT-ARGUMENT>
Listing A.6: DltArgument example for a measurement with a unit
<DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS>
<SHORT-NAME>reading</SHORT-NAME>
<NETWORK-REPRESENTATIONS>
<SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS>
<SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-VARIANTS>
<SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONDITIONAL>
<BASE-TYPE-REF DEST="SW-BASE-TYPE">/AUTOSAR_Platform/BaseTypes/
float32</BASE-TYPE-REF>
<UNIT-REF DEST="UNIT">/PhysicalUnits/Kelvin</UNIT-REF>
</SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-CONDITIONAL>
</SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS-VARIANTS>
</SW-DATA-DEF-PROPS>
</NETWORK-REPRESENTATIONS>
</DLT-ARGUMENT-PROPS>
Listing A.7: DltArgumentProps example for a measurement with a unit
The corresponding SwBaseType used for the DltArgument in this example is de-
picted in Listing A.8.
<SW-BASE-TYPE>
<SHORT-NAME>float32</SHORT-NAME>
<CATEGORY>FIXED_LENGTH</CATEGORY>
<BASE-TYPE-SIZE>32</BASE-TYPE-SIZE>
<BASE-TYPE-ENCODING>NONE</BASE-TYPE-ENCODING>
</SW
